## Codex execution contract

**CGS-11 design and consent contract:** Treat source task APIs and automatic hooks as optional; if unavailable, keep a transparent in-session checklist and do not claim task creation or hook execution. Use available file tools and preserve their permission limits. Classify and explain the change with actual context; retain the minimal-brief fallback when no GDD is expected. Obtain the required classification and filing decisions, and do not update a GDD without authorization for that change.
